featured_reviews.name: Sameer Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re looking for a store that handles everything from high-end appliances to daily essentials, Zee Electronics is the place to go. I have purchased from them twice now and have been fully satisfied both times.

They aren't just an "electronics" store. Whether you need a new fridge, the latest video games, or even something as small as pens, they have an incredible inventory.
Both of my purchases were seamless, and the products have been top-notch.
If you want a "one-step" shopping experience where you can grab a gaming console and household items in the same trip, Zee Electronics is brilliant. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Virendra Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fraud ,Fraud .......Fraud ...

I would like to bring to your attention a concerning experience I had with ZEE electronic Vile Parle (Manish), and I urge you all to be cautious in dealing with this establishment.

Recently, I purchased three appliances from this shop for ₹1.7 lakhs, which was promptly debited from my credit card. Before the purchase, Mr. Manish had assured me multiple times that there would be no additional charges beyond this amount. He also committed to delivering the appliances within three days.

However, after the payment was made, the promised delivery did not happen on time. I contacted Mr. Manish several times, but he began ignoring my calls. When I sent a message on WhatsApp, he responded apologetically and promised to deliver the appliances the same day, which again did not happen.

After repeated failed attempts to reach him, I eventually requested a cancellation and a refund. Only then, on the second day, did he manage to deliver the appliances.

To make matters worse, when my credit card statement arrived, I was shocked to see an additional charge of ₹7,000, which had not been disclosed. Upon contacting Mr. Manish, he initially expressed surprise and promised to look into the issue, but since that day, he has not responded to my calls or messages.

Given this highly unprofessional behavior and fraudulent charges, I strongly advise against purchasing anything from this shop. Their unethical practices are deceptive, and it is easy to fall victim to their schemes.

Please find attached the WhatsApp conversation as proof of this unfortunate experience.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I hope this serves as a warning to prevent others from facing similar issues.
